patch.description: After the mailbox moved onto the Config door, default values live in two places: core/config-standard/mailbox.yaml and packages/mailbox/contracts/limits.v1.json, kept equal by a host test. Make the effective snapshot section authoritative at runtime, so that a missing key is a named error, and make the crate tests read the bundled standard or a fixture taken from it. Then retire the contract defaults and the equality test. Open points: naming the exact missing key without a key list (serde_path_to_error or similar); the core crate's serde-only dependency rule; the frozen v7 measurement harness reads the contract by sha256; p95TargetMs and per-key metadata exist only in the contract. Asked for by CFG in its review of the mailbox config land. Also: the frozen measurement scripts (scripts/lib/mailbox-behaviour-score.mjs and mailbox-behaviour-v7*.mjs, LIMITS) hash limits.v1.json as the frozen limits, while the host now uses core/config-standard/mailbox.yaml; when the contract defaults retire, freeze the standard file in new measurements instead, without rewriting the frozen scripts of closed measurements.
